Log collector and stable log helpers for instruction, program, and debug messages.

# Purpose
This header defines the `fd_log_collector` interface used by the executor to store and format transaction logs. It provides inline functions to initialize the collector, add log messages, handle truncation, and encode messages in the internal tagged buffer format used by block storage. The file also includes helpers for stable log output such as `Program ... invoke`, `Program ... log`, `Program ... return`, `Program ... success`, `Program ... failed`, and `Program ... consumed`. Debug helpers at the end of the file can decode and print the stored logs for testing and inspection.
